parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphen (-).

parameters.name: VersionId
parameters.description: The ID of the policy version.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager set-default-policy-version --policy-name OSS-Administrator --version-id v2 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
